concept.title: Understand Open Cap or Floor Transactions
concept.shortdesc: This topic describes the calculation and general ledger posting process for opening cap and floor transactions.

conbody.p: When you open a cap or floor contract, the system calculates and stores the Local and Base Premium, calculates traded interest, creates an inventory position, uses the quantity as the first period's notional amount, and updates the general ledger.

section.title: Calculation for Open Cap or Floor Transaction
section.p: The system calculates the Local Premium Value (the Cost or Proceeds) to Open as follows: (Quantity * Quantity Scale) * (Price per Contract * Price Multiplier).
The system calculates the Base Premium Value as: Local Premium Value / Spot Exchange Rate to Base.

section.title: General Ledger Postings for Open Cap or Floor Transactions
section.p: When a contract opens, the system requires general ledger postings based on whether the Local Currency equals the Settle Currency and the Base Currency. The system handles Buy to Open and Sell to Open (Write) events differently based on these currency settings.
